Initial release of btcvision-oracle: AI-powered Bitcoin market intelligence skill.

- Provides real-time BTC/USD price data from Binance.
- Offers AI-driven BTC price predictions for 2027–2030 with methodology and historical accuracy metrics.
- Includes Bitcoin halving countdown, historical data, and cycle analysis.
- Delivers advanced on-chain market signals: MVRV Z-score, NVT ratio, Fear & Greed index, institutional flows.
- Supports MCP and A2A protocols with easy, modular endpoints.
- Free and community-funded, with no ads or paywall.
